#### The shapes of the digits

```{python}
#| code-fold: show
print(images.shape, images[0].shape, images[0, 3].shape, images[0, 3, 4].shape)
```

`images` has [shape](#def-shape) (`r py$n_images`, 8, 8):
`r py$n_images` images, each with 8 rows and 8 columns.
Indexing it drops the dimensions that the index fixes:
one image has shape (8, 8), one of its rows has shape (8,),
and one pixel has the empty shape ().

:::
